window: Editorial 24h assessment 2026-11-20 08:51:57 to 2026-11-21 08:51:57 America/Chicago; Ukraine Air Force preliminary 20 Nov 18:00–21 Nov 08:00 Kyiv time; Russian MoD 20 Nov 20:00–21 Nov 08:00 Moscow time. Windows differ; no synchronized totals.
reporting_side: Ukrainian Air Force via Ukrinform and RBC-Ukraine; Russian Defense Ministry via 8am.media/TASS and Voennoye Delo; civilian effects via Kyiv Independent and local-official accounts. All operational counts attributed, not independently verified.
notes: PRELIMINARY ATTRIBUTED COUNTS. Ukraine Air Force reports 148 drones including 87 jet-powered and three ballistic missiles; 117 drones shot down/suppressed as of 08:00 Kyiv; missile interceptions not specified/null. Russian MoD claims 275 drones intercepted in its separate 12h Moscow window, independently unverified. Ukraine Air Force reports impacts at 19 locations and debris at nine. Kryvyi Rih local officials report two dead (child and paramedic) and dozens injured; broader nationwide casualty reporting has different windows and is not aggregated. Kyiv morning missile strike and residential fires reported. Leningrad Oblast governor reports interceptions; Ust-Luga port strike is social-media allegation, unverified, excluded from confirmed impacts. No independently verified aircraft losses. No independently verified airspace closures. Historic 1,336 interception record claim excluded.
